newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade, with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Tuesday.
"Rates were narrowly mixed in the morning on some position adjustments. Most people are still waiting on the sidelines due to continued lack of fresh factors," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for possible direction from Thursday's issue of the retail sales figures and Friday's release of the producer price index," he said.
